toolZh: VS Code 中的 GitHub Copilot
title: Hands-on with GitHub Copilot
summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on with GitHub Copilot in VS Code, where the Agent role runs the loop and you supervise permissions, instructions files, and diffs.
summaryZh: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 VS Code 的 GitHub Copilot 里手把手教：由 Agent 角色跑闭环，你监督权限、指令文件与 diff。
outcome: The same tested report tool as the flagship course (identical contract and nine-test suite), driven with Copilot's Agent role — plus the Copilot workflow: Agent/Plan/Ask roles, Manual permissions, .github/copilot-instructions.md and applyTo instructions files, checkpoints, and Source Control diff review.
outcomeZh: 与旗舰课程相同的报表工具（同一契约、同一九测套件），改由 Copilot 的 Agent 角色驱动——外加 Copilot 工作流：Agent/Plan/Ask 角色、Manual permissions、.github/copilot-instructions.md 与 applyTo 指令文件、检查点，以及 Source Control 的 diff 评审。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
VS Code with GitHub Copilot signed in
Comfort running shell commands; no Python packages are installed
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
装有 VS Code 并已登录 GitHub Copilot
能运行 shell 命令；无需安装任何 Python 包

lessons.title: Set up Copilot in VS Code, install the FlyPython Skill, fetch the course
lessons.titleZh: 在 VS Code 里装好 Copilot、装上 FlyPython Skill、让 Agent 取回课程
lessons.objective: Get Copilot running with the Agent role and Manual permissions, let the agent fetch this course's files, and make the starter's failure objective.
lessons.objectiveZh: 让 Copilot 以 Agent 角色和 Manual permissions 跑起来，让 Agent 取回本课文件，并让 starter 的失败变得客观。

lessons.title: Write the task contract, let .github instructions carry the rules
lessons.titleZh: 写任务契约，让 .github 指令文件承载规则
lessons.objective: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then make it durable with .github/copilot-instructions.md and an applyTo instructions file.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把「改好一点」变成有边界、可测试的契约——再用 .github/copilot-instructions.md 和带 applyTo 的指令文件把它持久化。

lessons.title: The bounded change, reviewed turn by turn
lessons.objective: Drive the starter to green through bounded turns — review each turn's diff before the next, and use Restore Checkpoint and Git to keep every change yours.
lessons.objectiveZh: 通过有界的轮次把 starter 推到全绿——每轮先审 diff 再发下一轮，用 Restore Checkpoint 和 Git 守住每一处改动。

lessons.title: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
lessons.titleZh: 像评审者一样验证，别当观众
lessons.objective: Green tests are the floor: run both suites, walk a scenario skin, and review the accumulated diff in Source Control the way you would review a colleague's.
lessons.objectiveZh: 测试全绿只是地板：两个套件都跑、走完一个场景皮肤，并按评审同事的标准在 Source Control 里审这份累积 diff。

lessons.title: Take the workflow to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把工作流带回自己的项目
lessons.objective: Run the same loop — contract, instructions files, bounded agent work, diff review — with Copilot on a repository you actually own.
lessons.objectiveZh: 用 Copilot 在你真正拥有的仓库上跑同一套闭环：契约、指令文件、有界 Agent 工作、diff 评审。

scenarios.title: Excel / report automation
scenarios.blurb: Turn a messy weekly orders export into a per-region sales summary.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把混乱的每周订单导出变成按区域汇总的销售摘要。

scenarios.title: Data monitor script
scenarios.blurb: Aggregate service latency numbers and isolate malformed readings.
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总服务延迟数据，并隔离格式错误的读数。

scenarios.title: Small API tool
scenarios.blurb: Summarize ticket data pulled from an internal API (JSON input).
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总从内部 API 拉取的工单数据（JSON 输入）。

verification.method: The course ships the shared nine-test contract suite. The starter must reproduce seven named failures; the reviewed solution passes 9/9. The same suite verifies your own bounded change in lesson 3.
verification.methodZh: 课程自带共享的九个测试契约套件。starter 必须复现七个具名失败；已审核的实现 9/9 通过。第 3 课中同一套件验证你自己的最小变更。

badge.nameEn: Reproduce with Copilot in the loop

levelZh: 对新手友好；需要读代码的耐心
